industrial_maintenance.title: Industrial Maintenance & MTTR
industrial_maintenance.description: Maintenance lifecycle optimization through RAG intelligence. Our platform drastically reduces Mean Time To Repair (MTTR) by providing instant access to accumulated technical wisdom.
specs: Analysis of technical manuals >1000 pages in seconds
Automatic extraction of part numbers and procedures
Correlation of historical failures with current solutions
benefits: Elimination of errors due to obsolete manuals

conversational_search.title: Hybrid Conversational Search
conversational_search.description: It's not just a chat; it's an industrial-grade search engine that combines the best of three worlds to ensure absolute precision.
specs: Knowledge Graph (Neo4j): Navigation by technical relationships
Direct citations with links to PDF and exact page
Ranking adjusted by Human Feedback (HITL loop)
benefits: Zero hallucinations thanks to native Fact-Checking
Contextual answers that understand your industry
Massive time savings in document searching
